categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the textile industry, focusing on the manufacturing of long fiber woven fabrics, short fiber woven fabrics, yarns, and medical textiles. It also engages in industrial fabric production, garment fabrics, home decoration fabrics, and related services including dyeing and finishing. Additionally, the company is involved in international trade and investment in related textile and manufacturing enterprises.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced weaving technologies including water jet looms and air jet looms, with a focus on sustainable and eco-friendly production processes. It emphasizes R&D in high-strength nylon and recycled fiber fabrics, environmentally friendly dyeing techniques such as solution dyeing, and composite coating technologies. The production process integrates yarn preparation, weaving, sizing, drying, and finishing, with quality control and digital tools to enhance efficiency and product performance.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include international brands in the sportswear, outdoor, industrial, and medical sectors. The company serves markets requiring high-performance functional textiles such as industrial bags, outdoor gear, medical protective clothing, and home furnishings. Major end markets are in Europe, the United States, and Asia, with a focus on meeting the sustainability and performance demands of global brand clients.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates manufacturing facilities in Taiwan and mainland China, including Zhejiang and Jiangxi provinces. It has overseas investment holdings in the USA and Hong Kong. Its sales and export markets cover Europe, North America, and Asia, with significant export volumes to Vietnam, China, the US, Indonesia, and Cambodia. The company maintains a global supply chain and sales network to support its international customer base.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the textile supply chain, focusing on fabric weaving and finishing. It sources raw materials such as nylon and polyester fibers from upstream petrochemical and fiber producers and supplies finished fabrics to downstream garment manufacturers, brand owners, and industrial users. It also integrates downstream processes through dyeing and finishing operations to provide one-stop textile solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing sustainable and eco-friendly textiles aligned with global net-zero carbon goals, enhancing product functionality such as UV resistance, antimicrobial properties, and durability, and expanding into new application markets like medical textiles and high-protection industrial fabrics. The company invests in digital transformation, smart manufacturing, and R&D centers to foster innovation in recycled materials, low-carbon processes, and high-value-added products. It also pursues international environmental certifications to strengthen its green product portfolio.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of woven textile products including long fiber and short fiber fabrics, yarns, and medical textiles. The company also earns income from manufacturing services, dyeing and finishing operations, and international trade activities. Revenue streams include direct sales to brand customers, wholesale distribution, and export sales, with a focus on high-value functional and sustainable textile products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading midstream textile manufacturer in Taiwan with strong capabilities in functional and sustainable textiles. It competes with other regional textile producers in Asia that supply high-performance fabrics to global brands. Its competitive advantages include advanced weaving technology, integrated production processes, strong R&D in eco-friendly materials, and certifications such as Bluesign and GRS. The company aims to differentiate through innovation, sustainability, and digital supply chain integration.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2022, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$3.19 billion, representing a decline of 8.99% from the previous year, with net profit decreasing by 42.87% to about NT$80.6 million. The company has a stable asset base exceeding NT$3.8 billion and equity of over NT$2.1 billion. Despite recent revenue and profit declines due to market challenges, the company maintains a solid financial structure with ongoing investments in capacity expansion and R&D to support future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes delivering high-quality, sustainable, and functional textile products that meet stringent environmental and performance standards. Its value proposition includes advanced eco-friendly materials such as recycled nylon and polyester, low-impact dyeing processes, and innovative fabric structures offering durability, UV protection, antimicrobial features, and comfort. By integrating digital tools and sustainable practices, the company aims to provide differentiated products that align with global brand customers' sustainability goals and market demands.
